title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of 50 Solar-System bodies. Primary M2 remains frozen to five non-definitional conditions. Readiness-targeted evidence raises complete cases from 19 to 25 and passes the pre-frozen dwarf and satellite strata, while the small-body stratum remains blocked by live JPL SBDB numeric acquisition. Calibration remains closed.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C022 froze its sample, evidence ontology, M2 conditions and readiness gates before result inspection. Batch 06 targeted only predeclared readiness gaps, raising M2 substantive coverage to 34/34/28/36/34 and complete cases to 25/50. Dwarf and satellite stratum gates now pass; small bodies remain 0/16 complete because the numeric layer is unavailable. No calibration or QCA result has been inspected.
